text:
sasha: quick canary note: after leader shuffle some hot prefixes got evicted then immediately refetched. hypothesis: handoff leaves inconsistent recency across nodes. proposal: attach a small Ticket (node_id + counter) to residency and an access_epoch. eviction orders by (access_epoch, ticket) and new transfers get a short soft-pin.

mike: ticket namespace? node-local counter + node id? any wrap risk?

sasha: yes node-local 64-bit counter + stable node id. on restart node publishes a tombstone with its last counter so others treat counters below tombstone as expired. wrap is implausible.

anna: how avoid old tickets keeping stale entries alive if new owner never bumps them?

sasha: access_epoch bumped on access; eviction prefers higher epoch. ticket is only a deterministic tiebreak. plus soft-pin window on transfer to avoid instant eviction.

jordan: race: eviction at source while dest is pulling?

sasha: handshake sketch: source marks TRANSFERRING + last_ticket; dest pulls and ACKs adopting ticket; source defers eviction until ACK or timeout. eviction checks TRANSFERRING.

anna: rehydrate: background fills should request a ticket before promoting to resident, otherwise stay transient.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: FYI kv-cache/evict-ticket-sim flaky in CI; recent run 2/3 seeds passed, investigate https://ci.internal/12345

mike: rollout idea: advertise fields without changing comparator, gather telemetry, opt-in per-shard, then flip default. tests: comparator unit tests, tombstone recovery tests, chaos leader-failover+rehydrate+evict under load.

sasha: great; i'll draft RFC and tests and post link here when ready. :thumbsup:
